extDesc.message: Transcribe WhatsApp Web voice messages in the bubble. Groq, OpenAI or your own endpoint.

actionTranscribe.description: Link shown on a voice note that has no transcript yet

actionShow.description: Link that reopens a collapsed transcript

actionCopy.description: Copies the transcript to the clipboard

actionCopyFailed.description: Brief notice when copying did not work

actionHide.description: Collapses the transcript without deleting it

actionOpenOptions.description: Link in the error message, opens the options page

errPlaybackDidNotStart.message: Playback did not start: play the voice note manually and click again.

errAudioUnavailable.message: Could not retrieve the audio from the page.
errAudioUnavailable.description: The blob could not be resolved

errNoControl.description: The play button could not be located in the message row

errNoExtensionResponse.message: No response from the extension: reload the page.

errNoApiKey.description: No key saved for the selected provider

errRateLimit.message: Rate limit reached: try again shortly.

errAudioTooLarge.message: Audio too large for the provider's limit.

errAudioTooLargeLocal.message: Audio too large: $SIZE$ MB, the limit is $LIMIT$ MB.

errNetwork.message: Network error reaching the transcription service: check your connection and try again.
errNetwork.description: fetch threw — also covers a missing host permission

errBadResponse.message: The service returned an unreadable response.

errEmptyTranscription.message: Empty transcript: the voice note may contain no speech.

optSubtitle.message: Transcription of WhatsApp Web voice messages, using the provider of your choice.

optApiKeyHelpBefore.description: Text before the provider key link

optApiKeyHelpAfter.message: It is stored only in chrome.storage.local, on this computer.

optLanguageHelp.message: ISO-639-1 code: en, it, es… Leave empty for automatic detection.

optRetentionHelp.message: After this period they are deleted automatically. The sweep runs at browser start and every 12 hours; expired entries are discarded as soon as the message comes back into view. A voice note with an expired transcript simply needs transcribing again.

optSavedNoKey.message: Saved, but without an API key transcription will not start.

optProvider.description: Field label: which transcription service to use

optProviderHelp.message: Any service that speaks the OpenAI audio transcription API. Each provider keeps its own key.
optProviderHelp.description: Help text under the provider selector

optBaseUrlHelp.message: The OpenAI-compatible base, for example https://my-server/v1 — the extension appends /audio/transcriptions. Plain http is allowed only for localhost.
optBaseUrlHelp.description: Help text for the base URL field

optBaseUrlMalformed.message: That is not a valid URL.

optBaseUrlInsecure.message: Plain http is allowed only for localhost — elsewhere the API key would travel unencrypted.

optModelPlaceholder.description: Placeholder for the custom model field

optGrantAccess.description: Button that requests the host permission

optAccessNeeded.message: This provider needs your permission before the extension can contact it.

errNoBaseUrl.message: No endpoint URL set for the custom provider.
errNoBaseUrl.description: Custom provider selected but no base URL saved
